_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: momentum/funding/F&G sit mid-band with no range break, so HOLD toward Complacency is the graded call until a breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on phase so no contradiction but no confirmation
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-58, 30d momentum ~45-58, funding near flat, no range break
next_move.invalidated_if: momentum under ~40 with funding negative and F&G under 47, or flow/volume impulse drives F&G through 63
